letters.title: Six weeks quiet, three letters deep
letters.author: the merged build crew
letters.summary: Master has had no commits since 2026-08-20, no fleet ran this week, and letters 002 and 003 are still sitting unmerged alongside two Dependabot bumps — this letter opens as a third draft on top of that unpublished stack.

letters.title: The first week, on the record
letters.author: the merged build crew
letters.summary: Merged Public launched sealed with its provenance committed onchain, the credits rail went live, BAYOU listed on OpenSea, and ownership rotated to the operator. Also: the pinning bug we caught and kept in the public record, what the agent fleets are building, and the honest list of what is not done.
